title: Simpulan Terakhir
genre: Malay Neapolitan tarantella-pop (mandolin-and-accordion fast 6/8 folk dance)
subject: a children's-party magician who has pulled the same chain of silk scarves from his sleeve for twenty-five years, and tonight his wife-assistant finds a ring knotted in the last scarf, the ring he could not afford at their wedding
caption: Malay Neapolitan tarantella-pop, galloping 6/8 folk dance with a spinning accelerating feel. Mandolin tremolo playing the hook, accordion pumping chords, tambourine shaking on the pulse, nylon guitar strumming, upright bass on the downbeats. Dry live-room folk-ensemble sound, tambourine forward. Male baritone, warm mid register, bright conversational sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 124 BPM, A minor. Playful, giddy and tender mood. No electric guitar, no synths, no drum kit, no autotune, no pop-trap drift, no ragtime piano.
lyrics:
[Intro - mandolin tremolo, tambourine]
[Verse 1]
Dua puluh lima tahun aku tarik skarf
Merah, kuning, hijau, semuanya sama
Budak bertepuk, mak-mak angkat telefon
Isteri berdiri tepi, pegang topi
[Pre-Chorus]
Malam ni lain sikit, tangan aku sejuk
Ada simpulan di hujung skarf biru
[Chorus]
Tarik, tarik, tarik perlahan
Ini bukan silap mata, sayang
Dua puluh lima tahun kau tunggu
Cincin ni baru aku mampu
[Verse 2]
Dulu kita kahwin tanpa cincin
Kau kata, "Nanti kau sulap sendiri"
Aku simpan lima ringgit tiap kali show
Dalam kotak topi, bawah kain baldu
[Pre-Chorus]
Budak-budak menjerit, "Makcik, tengok tangan!"
Jari kau menggeletar buka simpulan
[Chorus]
Tarik, tarik, tarik perlahan
Ini bukan helah, ini betul
Dua puluh lima tahun kau sabar
Cincin ni sekarang kau pakai
[Bridge - accordion, mandolin]
Kotak gergaji pun diam menunggu
Merpati pun tak berani bunyi
[Chorus]
Tarik, tarik, tarik perlahan
Satu tepukan paling kuat
Dua puluh lima tahun, kita berdua
Cincin ni muat, ta-da, muat
[Outro - mandolin, accordion, tambourine]
